entries.name: linearmodels/recipe/estimate-model-parameters
entries.summary: Estimate model parameters.

recipe.title: Estimate model parameters.
recipe.code:
from linearmodels import BetweenOLS
from linearmodels.datasets import wage_panel
data = wage_panel.load().set_index(["nr", "year"])
y = data["lwage"]
x = data[["married", "union"]]
mod = BetweenOLS(y, x)
res = mod.fit(cov_type='robust')

entries.name: linearmodels/recipe/jackknife-instrumental-variables-estimator-jive
entries.summary: Jackknife instrumental variables estimator (JIVE).

recipe.title: Jackknife instrumental variables estimator (JIVE).
recipe.code:
import numpy as np
from linearmodels.iv import IVJIVE
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n = 500
z = rng.standard_normal((n, 3))
x = z[:, 0] + rng.standard_normal(n)
exog = np.ones((n, 1))
y = x + rng.standard_normal(n)
mod = IVJIVE(y, exog, x[:, None], z)
res = mod.fit()

data["year"] = year
print(wage_panel.DESCR)
print(data.head())
